name: 5-MeO-AET
summary: 5-MeO-αET, also known as 5-methoxy-α-ethyltryptamine, is a psychoactive drug of the tryptamine and α-alkyltryptamine families. It reportedly produces psychedelic and stimulant effects.

pharmacology.text: The pharmacology of 5-MeO-αET has been studied. It is a weak partial agonist of the serotonin 5-HT2A receptor, with a binding affinity (Ki) of 4,073 nM, an EC50 of 166 nM, and an Emax of 34%. For comparison, αET showed 14-fold lower affinity for the receptor than 5-MeO-αET and was inactive as an agonist of the receptor. The individual stereoisomers of 5-MeO-αET and αET were also assessed.
pharmacology.kind: Serotonin 5-HT2A receptor agonist; Serotonergic psychedelic; Hallucinogen

uses.en: It has been reported as a designer drug used recreationally. It has no medical use.
uses.zh: 它曾被報告作為設計師藥物供娛樂使用，沒有醫療用途。
uses.zhHans: 它曾被报告作为设计师药物供娱乐使用，没有医疗用途。

sideEffects.en: Little is known about it in people. Related α-alkyltryptamines such as αET and αMT can cause nausea, muscle tension, a racing heart, overheating, anxiety and restlessness, and can raise the risk of serotonin syndrome, which can be life-threatening.
sideEffects.zh: 目前對它在人體的作用所知甚少。相關的α-烷基色胺類（例如αET與αMT）可能引起噁心、肌肉緊繃、心跳急促、體溫過高、焦慮與坐立不安，也可能提高血清素症候群的風險，這種狀況可能危及生命。
sideEffects.zhHans: 目前对它在人体的作用所知甚少。相关的α-烷基色胺类（例如αET与αMT）可能引起恶心、肌肉紧绷、心跳急促、体温过高、焦虑与坐立不安，也可能提高血清素症候群的风险，这种状况可能危及生命。

fact.en: Its parent αET was sold briefly in the early 1960s as the antidepressant Monase. Adding a methoxy group at the 5 position gives a drug reported to be both psychedelic and stimulating.
fact.zh: 它的母體αET曾在1960年代初期以抗憂鬱藥「Monase」的名稱短暫販售。在第5位加上甲氧基後，得到的藥物據報告既有迷幻作用也有興奮作用。
fact.zhHans: 它的母体αET曾在1960年代初期以抗忧郁药「Monase」的名称短暂贩售。在第5位加上甲氧基后，得到的药物据报告既有迷幻作用也有兴奋作用。
